name: Pizza
how: For a quick homemade pizza, grab some pizza dough, tomato sauce, cheese, and your favorite toppings from the supermarket. Assemble everything and bake until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling.

name: Salad
how: Pick up some fresh lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, and whatever vegetables you like. Chop everything, mix it in a bowl, and finish with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

name: Sweet Potato
how: Grab a sweet potato from the supermarket, wash it well, and bake it until soft. You can enjoy it as it is or add a little butter, salt, cinnamon, or your favorite seasoning.

name: Gnocchi
how: Buy some ready-made gnocchi, boil them until they float, and toss them with your favorite sauce. Tomato sauce, pesto, or butter with herbs all work beautifully.

name: Pot Roast
how: Pick up a good cut of beef, potatoes, carrots, onions, and some stock. Brown the meat first, then let everything cook slowly together until the beef becomes tender and flavorful.

name: Lasagna
how: For a comforting lasagna, get lasagna sheets, tomato sauce, minced meat, mozzarella, and some béchamel sauce. Layer everything in a baking dish and bake until golden and bubbling.

name: Hamburger
how: Grab burger buns, minced beef, cheese, lettuce, tomato, and your favorite sauce. Shape and cook the beef patty, then build your burger and enjoy it fresh.

name: Pad Thai
how: Get rice noodles, eggs, vegetables, peanuts, and Pad Thai sauce. Stir-fry everything together in a hot pan and finish with crushed peanuts and a squeeze of lime.

name: Almonds
how: No cooking needed here. Just grab a bag of almonds from the supermarket and enjoy them as a simple snack. You can also add them to yogurt, oatmeal, or salads.

name: Sarma
how: For sarma, you will need grape leaves, rice, minced meat, onion, and herbs. Prepare the filling, wrap it carefully in the leaves, and simmer the rolls slowly until tender.

name: Bacon
how: This one is easy: grab some bacon and cook it in a pan until it reaches your favorite level of crispiness. Add it to breakfast, sandwiches, burgers, or salads.

name: Hot Dog
how: Pick up some hot dog sausages, buns, mustard, ketchup, and any toppings you like. Heat the sausages, put them in the buns, and finish with your favorite sauces.

name: Chocolate Cake
how: For a chocolate cake, you will need flour, cocoa powder, sugar, eggs, butter, and milk. Mix the ingredients into a smooth batter and bake until the cake is soft and rich.

name: Wheat Bread
how: For homemade wheat bread, mix whole-wheat flour, water, yeast, salt, and a little oil. Let the dough rise, shape it into a loaf, and bake until golden brown.

name: Orange
how: No recipe needed for this one! Pick a fresh orange from the supermarket, peel it, and enjoy it as a refreshing snack. You can also squeeze it into fresh orange juice.

name: Banana
how: Another easy one! Grab a banana, peel it, and eat it. For something more interesting, slice it over yogurt, oatmeal, or toast with peanut butter.

name: Yogurt
how: Grab some yogurt from the supermarket and enjoy it straight from the fridge. Add fresh fruit, honey, nuts, or granola if you want to turn it into a more exciting snack.
